versions.content: If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled UdpNm shall stay in the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode for a configurable amount of time determined by the UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (configuration parameter); after that time the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode shall be left and the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be entered.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled UdpNm shall stay in the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode for a configurable amount of time determined by the UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (configuration parameter); after that time the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode shall be left and the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be entered.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled UdpNm shall stay in the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode for a configurable amount of time determined by the UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (configuration parameter); after that time the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode shall be left and the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be entered.

If UdpNmStayInPbsEnabled is disabled UdpNm shall stay in the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode for a configurable amount of time determined by the UdpNmWaitBusSleepTime (configuration parameter); after that time the Prepare Bus-Sleep Mode shall be left and the Bus-Sleep Mode shall be entered.
